title: `format` and `Format` in the same object

source.clause: §5 ("Capitalization is not relevant to the name or value of the field")
source.note: composed: negative case for §5. Two spellings of one field name, which §5 makes the same field; the standard says nothing about which value wins, so the crate refuses rather than choosing (README, "Case, and the order of submessages").

notes: Both spellings carry the same value here, so a resolving implementation would see nothing wrong. The corpus pins the refusal anyway: the rule is about the ambiguity, not about whether it happens to matter.
